title: Restriction preserves the constructed K-flat coefficient currying comparison
statement: On a small ringed site let modelCurryIso be the evaluation-normalized derived currying comparison constructed from K-flat representatives [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-model-currying]. There are natural derived internal-Hom restriction isomorphisms e_U and s_a, compatible with the canonical successive-slice comparison. For any arrow a:V→U, any sheaf coefficients S on C/U and T on C/V with K-flat degree-zero complexes, any isomorphism xi:S|V≅T, any complex P whose restrictions to C/U and C/V are K-flat, and any unbounded derived object N, restriction of modelCurryIso(S,P,N) equals modelCurryIso(T,P,N) after the already constructed coefficient and tensor-complex transports [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-model-restriction]. The currying, coefficient and tensor isomorphisms, and currying naturality, are already constructed; this assertion supplies the restriction comparisons and their compatibility with those fixed maps.

source.place: Tags 08JB, 0A90 and 0A96; the sectionwise evaluation argument in the proof of 08JB and the tensor-Hom composition comparison.

proof.text: Choose functorial K-injective target models. Exact slice restriction preserves the models and K-injectivity. Compare Hom complexes by the product projections and the equivalence between an iterated slice over W and C/W. The differential and both module maps are unchanged; descend these natural chain comparisons to obtain e and s. On one further slice the two successive restrictions evaluate exactly the same local maps, giving their composition equation.

K-flatness of P|U implies that Hom(P|U,I|U) is K-injective. Thus the nested derived Hom is computed by the two nested Hom complexes. In the construction of modelCurryIso, the chain currying map evaluates phi(s)(p). Restricting this evaluation, or evaluating after restriction, gives the same section on each W over V. The prescribed xi acts on the coefficient and its inverse acts contravariantly on Hom. The constructed tensor restriction is the sheafification of restriction of presheaf pure tensors, so these transports give the same equation.

Use pure tensors before sheafification to prove equality of the tensor maps, then the coproduct and product universal properties to prove equality of chain maps. Apply Q and use naturality of the exact-restriction factors and the canonical representative comparisons to cancel the transports. Localization gives the equation for every derived target N. No boundedness, nonzero-ring, or nonempty-site condition was used.

theorem modelCurrying_restriction (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u}) :
    ∃ (e : ∀ U : C,
      localizationRHom R ⋙ localizationDerivedRestriction R U ≅
        ((localizationDerivedRestriction R U).op.prod
          (localizationDerivedRestriction R U)) ⋙ localizationRHom (R.over U))
      (s : ∀ (U V : C) (a : V ⟶ U),
        localizationRHom (R.over U) ⋙ localizationDerivedOverMap R a ≅
          ((localizationDerivedOverMap R a).op.prod (localizationDerivedOverMap R a)) ⋙
            localizationRHom (R.over V)),
      (∀ (U V : C) (a : V ⟶ U) (L M : localizationDerived R),
        (localizationDerivedOverMap R a).map ((e U).hom.app (op L, M)) ≫
          (s U V a).hom.app
            (op ((localizationDerivedRestriction R U).obj L),
              (localizationDerivedRestriction R U).obj M) ≫
          (localizationRHom (R.over V)).map
            (X := (op ((localizationDerivedOverMap R a).obj
              ((localizationDerivedRestriction R U).obj L)),
              (localizationDerivedOverMap R a).obj
                ((localizationDerivedRestriction R U).obj M)))
            (Y := (op ((localizationDerivedRestriction R V).obj L),
              (localizationDerivedRestriction R V).obj M))
            (((localizationRestrictionCompIso R a).inv.app L).op,
              (localizationRestrictionCompIso R a).hom.app M) =
        (localizationRestrictionCompIso R a).hom.app
          ((localizationRHom R).obj (op L, M)) ≫ (e V).hom.app (op L, M)) ∧
      ∀ (U V : C) (a : V ⟶ U)
        (S : localizationModules (R.over U)) (T : localizationModules (R.over V))
        (ξ : (moduleOverMap R a).obj S ≅ T)
        (hS : KFlatRHom.flat (R.over U)
          ((HomologicalComplex.single (localizationModules (R.over U)) (.up ℤ) 0).obj S))
        (hT : KFlatRHom.flat (R.over V)
          ((HomologicalComplex.single (localizationModules (R.over V)) (.up ℤ) 0).obj T))
        (P : CochainComplex (localizationModules R) ℤ)
        (hPU : KFlatRHom.flat (R.over U) ((localizationComplexRestriction R U).obj P))
        (hPV : KFlatRHom.flat (R.over V) ((localizationComplexRestriction R V).obj P))
        (N : localizationDerived R),
          (localizationDerivedOverMap R a).map ((modelCurryIso R U S hS P hPU N).hom) ≫
            (s U V a).hom.app
              (op ((localizationQ (R.over U)).obj ((coefficientComplex R U S).obj P)),
                (localizationDerivedRestriction R U).obj N) ≫
            (localizationRHom (R.over V)).map
              (X := (op ((localizationDerivedOverMap R a).obj
                ((localizationQ (R.over U)).obj ((coefficientComplex R U S).obj P))),
                (localizationDerivedOverMap R a).obj
                  ((localizationDerivedRestriction R U).obj N)))
              (Y := (op ((localizationQ (R.over V)).obj
                ((coefficientComplex R V T).obj P)),
                (localizationDerivedRestriction R V).obj N))
              (((coefficientDerivedComplexIso R a S T ξ).inv.app P).op,
                (localizationRestrictionCompIso R a).hom.app N) =
          (s U V a).hom.app
            (op (derivedCoefficient R U S),
              (localizationRHom (R.over U)).obj
                (op ((localizationDerivedRestriction R U).obj ((localizationQ R).obj P)),
                  (localizationDerivedRestriction R U).obj N)) ≫
            (localizationRHom (R.over V)).map
              (X := (op ((localizationDerivedOverMap R a).obj
                (derivedCoefficient R U S)),
                (localizationDerivedOverMap R a).obj ((localizationRHom (R.over U)).obj
                  (op ((localizationDerivedRestriction R U).obj ((localizationQ R).obj P)),
                    (localizationDerivedRestriction R U).obj N))))
              (Y := (op (derivedCoefficient R V T),
                (localizationRHom (R.over V)).obj
                  (op ((localizationDerivedRestriction R V).obj ((localizationQ R).obj P)),
                    (localizationDerivedRestriction R V).obj N)))
              ((derivedCoefficientIso R a S T ξ).inv.op,
                (s U V a).hom.app
                  (op ((localizationDerivedRestriction R U).obj ((localizationQ R).obj P)),
                    (localizationDerivedRestriction R U).obj N) ≫
                (localizationRHom (R.over V)).map
                  (X := (op ((localizationDerivedOverMap R a).obj
                    ((localizationDerivedRestriction R U).obj ((localizationQ R).obj P))),
                    (localizationDerivedOverMap R a).obj
                      ((localizationDerivedRestriction R U).obj N)))
                  (Y := (op ((localizationDerivedRestriction R V).obj ((localizationQ R).obj P)),
                    (localizationDerivedRestriction R V).obj N))
                  (((localizationRestrictionCompIso R a).inv.app ((localizationQ R).obj P)).op,
                    (localizationRestrictionCompIso R a).hom.app N)) ≫
            (modelCurryIso R V T hT P hPV N).hom
